definitions.explanation: The quality of being fresh, especially regarding food such as fish, meat, and vegetables. Can also be used figuratively for the freshness of information or ideas.

examples.japanese: {鮮度|せんど}が{落|お}ちている。
{鮮度|せんど}のいい{魚|さかな}を{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please choose fish with good freshness.

examples.japanese: この{市場|いちば}は{朝|あさ}{獲|と}れの{魚|さかな}が{並|なら}ぶので、{鮮度|せんど}は{抜群|ばつぐん}だ。
examples.english: This market lines up fish caught that morning, so the freshness is outstanding.

notes:
Compound of {鮮|せん} (fresh) + {度|ど} (degree).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮮度|せんど}が{高|たか}い (high freshness)
- {鮮度|せんど}が{落|お}ちる (freshness drops)
- {鮮度|せんど}を{保|たも}つ (maintain freshness)
- {鮮度|せんど}{抜群|ばつぐん} (outstanding freshness)

Primarily used for food, especially seafood. Figuratively, {情報|じょうほう}の{鮮度|せんど} (freshness of information) refers to how current or up-to-date information is.
